summary: Davis is a Docker-ready administration interface for sabre/dav servers, built using PHP, Symfony, and Bootstrap. It provides a web-based panel to manage CalDAV and CardDAV data similar to the Baikal server interface. It is licensed under the MIT licence and relies on existing sabre/dav backend storage.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you already run a sabre/dav backend and require a straightforward web interface for administration without heavy resource demands.
watchOut: The project has a relatively low maintenance health score and slowing update velocity, meaning you may encounter unpatched bugs or lag behind upstream PHP releases.
deployNotes: As a PHP application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
